candidates.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE complete isolated ancient Liao/Jin northern Chinese town gatehouse game asset, on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, no halo or colored background. Realistic matte hand-painted architectural sprite, fine grey clay tiles, rough grey-ochre rammed earth, modest grey brick footings, dark brown wood. One low timber gallery with restrained hipped roof bridges two piers. No text, signs, people, scenery, flags, pavement, ground patch, stairs or platform. Lighting upper left, tiny contact shading only.
GEOMETRY: a high isometric 2:1 RPG game map view with an orthographic camera. View equally toward the front and the right side, yaw45 elevation30. All ground edges along the long facade descend screen-right at exact slope+0.5; all depth edges ascend screen-right at slope-0.5. Both axes equal26.565degrees to horizontal. No perspective. Vertical walls.
The plan is exactly TEN units along the facade and FOUR units deep. The two solid end piers are each TWO units wide and FOUR units deep. The central opening is SIX units wide and FOUR units deep: facade proportion20% pier /60% empty opening /20% pier. Big airy opening with alpha transparency through the full gate depth. Each pier is twice as deep as its width, showing substantial side faces. The front facade projected horizontal span is2.5 times the projected depth span. A genuinely deep gatehouse, not a shallow wall. Bottom masonry edges clean and clearly measurable. Match the quiet realistic historical grey-tile aesthetic of Song-era map kits, heavy plain wood brackets, no elaborate palace paint. Whole eaves and feet inside generous transparent margin. Exactly one sprite.
